goal: Each team lead uses Claude to draft the weekly team report from the team's task tracker and checks every line against it before sending.

weekly_goals.goal: Get comfortable asking Claude for a first draft and revising it.
Draft the weekly report from tracker data.
Check a draft line by line against its source before sending.

criteria.check: Each lead produces a report draft from a tracker export with Claude.
criteria.pass_if: a draft exists for every lead

criteria.check: Each lead flags at least one line the tracker does not support.
criteria.pass_if: one flagged line per lead, with the tracker row it was checked against

constraints: Tracker exports are read-only copies of real data; nothing is written back to the tracker.
Practice reports use the sample tracker file supplied by the presenter.

participant_profile.learner: Team leads who already write the weekly report by hand

glossary.weekly report: A one-page summary of the team's week, sent every Friday.
glossary.task tracker: The tool the team logs its work in.
glossary.status code: UNRESOLVED: the tracker's status values are not yet listed
